details.description: GPT-4.1 mini is OpenAI's smaller, faster version of GPT-4.1, built for instruction following and tool calling with low latency and no reasoning step. This catalog entry is the gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 snapshot as OpenAI's fine-tuning API exposes it, letting a user create a custom fine-tuned model on top of it via supervised fine-tuning or direct preference optimization. Its knowledge cutoff is June 1, 2024.
advantages: OpenAI's fine-tuning guide lists gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 as supporting both supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO).
OpenAI's model page describes it as excelling at instruction following and tool calling with low latency and no reasoning step.
disadvantages: OpenAI's model page recommends starting with GPT-5 mini instead for more complex tasks.
use_cases: Creating a custom fine-tuned model (via SFT or DPO) for narrower tasks such as classification, specialized translation, or consistent formatting.
General instruction-following and tool-calling tasks where low latency matters.

notes: Catalog facts list only text_input/text_output modality for this fine-tuning-specific entry, while OpenAI's general gpt-4.1-mini model page also lists image input support for normal chat use; kept the catalog's modality per instructions and did not restate image input. No deprecation notice found for this snapshot on OpenAI's deprecations page.
